verdict.rationale: Fenwick & West is a law firm. Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-authored automations is a category error for a legal services provider. Fenwick Labs' firm-built tools (document generation, alerts, extranets) are not user-configurable automations with version control, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
